correctness.rationale: The strict Jury conditions for z^2-ap z-a(1-p) are |a|(1-p)<1, a<1, and 1+a(2p-1)>0; their convex-weight feasible union is -3<a<1, whereas p=1/2 permits -2<a<1. Yule-Walker elimination yields V/sigma^2=(1-a+ap)/[(1+a-ap)(1-a)(1-a+2ap)]. Symbolic differentiation gives d(V/sigma^2)/dp=2a^2 Q_a(p)/[(1-a)(1+a-ap)^2(1-a+2ap)^2]; Q has its unique feasible root p*=sqrt(1-a)/(1+sqrt(1-a)), is negative before, positive after, and p* passes all strict Jury conditions. At a=0 all weights tie at sigma^2. With t=sqrt(1-a), V*=sigma^2/[t^2(2-t)^2] and (a+3)^2 V*/sigma^2 ->4. Independent sympy exact derivative, exact-radical substitutions and limit passed, corroborating the algebra.
